title: Implement G03 fresh source inventory and reconciliation candidate
goal: Port C2c source-derived G03 claims to a read-only V4 Post extension while deferring API/schema snapshot parity to C2c2.
acceptanceCriteria: The Post extension freshly scans source, excludes generated directories, checks exact Phase 9 source counts, reconciles public surfaces and provider/consumer evidence, and checks active legacy field inventories against source records.
Clean, violating, missing, stale, linked-path and zero-source fixtures, source/hash checks, synthetic published-Host Post and TargetRoot byte invariance pass.
Formal Pre/Diff, isolated package regression and published Package identity pass; C2c2 deterministic snapshot and C2d/C2e claims remain explicitly missing.
